sentences.text: 1 4. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the informant was married around 25 years ago and her husband had left India around 10 years ago for livelihood.

The allegations were levelled that the real brother-in-law, the applicant had administered something to her in Pepsi and thereafter committed rape on her and also made a video and thereafter on the pretext of making the video viral used to commit sexual assault on her.
It was also alleged that he had taken certain money from the informant under the threat of making video viral.
In the statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C., it was alleged that the said offence was committed 5 years ago.
Similar statement was given under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
The informant refused to undergo medical examination as is clear from Annexure-6 to the bail application.
5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the fact that bald allegations were levelled against the entire family members; the allegations against the applicant were of five years ago without there being any specification about the time, place or year of the incident; the informant herself was aged about 45 years of age, thus,
apart from the statement under Section 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C., there is no material to corroborate the allegations and the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 27.08.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
